title: Privacy notice
body:
This site collects as little personal information as possible.

## What is collected

* **Contact form:** your name, email address, optional affiliation and your message.
* **Comments:** your name, email address (never published), optional affiliation and your comment.
* **Email updates:** your email address, if you choose to subscribe.

## How it is used

Information is used only to reply to you, to moderate and publish comments, and to send the updates you asked for. It is not sold or shared for marketing.

## Where it is stored

Form submissions are stored by the website host which is Netlify. If you subscribe, your email address is stored by Netlify

## How long it is kept

I will keep messages, comments and subscriber details until the end of my programme, then delete them.

## Your choices

You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email, or ask for your information to be corrected or deleted through the [contact form](#/contact).

## Cookies and analytics

This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Display preferences (such as text size) are saved only in your own browser.

*Last updated: October 2026*
